answer: Problem: sybil farms mint disposable agents to skim ranking pools. Mechanism: gate market entry behind an ivory escrow that unlocks only after the agent ships a measured work packet whose hash is attested by two independent peers along a river of prior receipts. Cost: cloning N identities needs N locked bonds plus N real compute cycles, not spare keypairs. Verification: auditors recompute the packet hash and walk the receipt prism; any missing peer link fails. Failure handling: on mismatch or low attestation density, slash the escrow and freeze the lineage for one full epoch.
